run.change_description: [field] Sync controlled value changes with field state

summary.intent: Make `Field.Control` sync controlled value changes through `useValueChanged` (one owner per mode), register the serialized value so dirty state clears for non-string values, and honor `details.cancel()`. Source: the supplied pull-request text; the single commit message only restates the title.
summary.issue_fit: Issue alignment unavailable: no originating issue. Every ledger row from the PR text is met, except that `details.cancel()` stops validation and error-clearing but not dirty/filled updates in uncontrolled mode (a note, not a defect).
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff (2 files) reviewed with `useValueChanged`, the field registration and validation code, and sibling controls read. Reviewer-executed at the head, offline jsdom: `packages/react/src/field` (10 files, 240 passed, 9 skipped) and a scratch probe of edge cases. Chromium and rendered output were unavailable. No must-fix or risk-area candidate survived, so no verification batch was dispatched. Recorded PR performance figures were not re-measured.

observations.fact: In controlled mode `onChange` now returns before the `defaultPrevented` guard, so a controlled value that changes despite a prevented `input` event still clears errors and validates; the uncontrolled path still skips both (the existing prevented-change test covers only the uncontrolled path).
observations.evidence: `packages/react/src/field/control/FieldControl.tsx:105-113` and `:143-154`; a scratch probe with a canceled-capture `input` listener counted 1 validate call.

observations.fact: In uncontrolled mode a canceled `onValueChange` skips validation and error clearing, but `setDirty` and `setFilled` still run, which matches the DOM text that stays in the input.
observations.evidence: `packages/react/src/field/control/FieldControl.tsx:143-151`; scratch probe: dirty and filled true after cancel.
